basic_profile.bio: Based in Toronto, Canada, I'm a 32-year-old mechanical engineer with a passion for Pokemon and motorsports. I spend my weekends either trading Pokemon or attending local car races. Married with no kids, my wife and I own a Golden Retriever named Max. I usually log into Reddit during evenings after work or on weekends. I'm also interested in sustainable living and exploring past life theories.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering from McMaster University. My expertise in Pokemon games comes from years of playing since the early Game Boy editions. I am self-taught in recycling and sustainability practices, often sharing insights on these topics.
